messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Dm_tiling2_MR_v01.bpmap to Dm_tiling2_MR_v01.cdf conversion
parts:
Hi "hanat T",

I've looked at this and chatted with Mark Robinson about it and this
turns out to be a bug in bpmapCluster2Cdf(); it tries to exclude
non-genomic control sequences and it turns out it is too conservative
in what it calls a control sequence (cf. http://goo.gl/cjGnZ). This
bug had no/very little impact on the Human tiling arrays, which was
what he wrote the function for.

FYI, I've fixed this for aroma.affymetrix v2.5.4. However, it will be
a while before that is released on CRAN (too many confounded
dependencies), but if you're eager you may try to install it from
R-forge (when they update their servers).

Also, your are referring to an old version of the above function
(http://129.94.136.7/file_dump/mark/bpmapCluster2Cdf.R). Not sure how
you found that, but from now on you should only use
http://aroma-project.org/howtos/bpmapCluster2Cdf

/Henrik
